title: Dynamic Status Changes
author: Neal Mitchell
content:
A new feature introduced in fastProject 4.7.3 is a dynamic status indicator in the Inspector. As the schedule changes, this information is updated in real-time. So after an Update, you can very quickly see:

  • If a target is ahead or behind schedule

  • By how much

  • The likelihood of hitting the target

  • The change since he later of the last update or Wigglechart

As you pull-in the schedule, you will see this change reflected in the top left of the Inspector. So make sure to pay attention to this part of the screen.

The schedule data on the left is based on what ever target/task is selected to the right (below).
